events.title: Performance and Balance Update
events.summary: BALANCE- Bow: 12 damage (was 10), attacks 10% faster.- Arrow Rain: 25% larger, lasts 2.8 s, deals 84 damage (was 60).- Death Ray: damage ramps from 0.5x to 3x on each enemy over 4 s of beam, then cools down over 3 s.- Overcharge: cooldown 10 s (was 12).- Towers: 10 damage (was 8). Rapid Fire 2x attack speed (was 1.67x). Heavy Bolts +7 damage (was +4). Barrage keeps its attack speed.- Fortress: 10 / 15 / 20 damage per hit by tier.- Stormcaller: its strike also pauses a Barracks' respawn for 3 s.M

events.title: Demo update
events.summary: QoL FeaturesTroops fight while following you. Followers attack enemies in reach, join in on your hero's target and use their abilities. Arrow Rain now hits flying enemies where you see them. A flier inside the circle on screen gets hit instead of having to aim at their shadows. Troops holding position defend each other. events.title: The Homeguard Demo is out
events.summary: The demo is out! The free Homeguard demo is out now on Steam. Build your kingdom by day, then ride out on your walking throne and defend it yourself by night. What's in the demo Two maps : Amberfjord and Sunscar Canyon Three weapons: the bow, the death ray and the daggers, each with its own ability Online co-op for up to four players Played the demo before? The second level is now available if you already completed amberfjord. Tell us what you think Every review and comment helps. Leave a review
